title: Liveness Grammar + Convergence Certification
summary: Unifies backpressure and retirement into one four-state liveness event (ready, saturated, retiring, dead). Adds schema gate at the byte-to-typed-event boundary, tombstone module with three-window proof, convergence check in verify.sh using sum 1/n^2 against pi^2/6, reopen threshold when a single discovery exceeds the remaining tail, and enforcement-ratio census with floor at 2:1. Includes minimal relay_loop.py so test_integration.py stops importing an 11-byte stub.
